traceability.notes:
Story 021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX is fully implemented.
The require-test-traceability rule and its helpers implement both major behaviors: (1) inserting a file-level @supports placeholder JSDoc with clear TODO guidance when missing, and (2) normalizing malformed `[REQ-XXX]` prefixes in test names (spacing, underscores vs hyphens, parentheses vs brackets, and casing) only when a REQ identifier already exists. Configuration flags (`autoFixTestTemplate`, `autoFixTestPrefixFormat`, `testSupportsTemplate`) are present and honored, and all fixes are limited to comments and name string literals, preserving test behavior and structure.
Tests in tests/rules/require-test-traceability.test.ts are explicitly mapped to this story’s requirements and cover all described auto-fix scenarios, including the no-inference case where missing prefixes are reported but not auto-fixed. Jest test output confirms these tests pass. User-facing documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md documents the auto-fix capabilities and template behavior for this rule. Collectively, this satisfies all acceptance criteria and the story’s definition of done.
